summary: Bulk Create Action Plans for Assets
description:
Creates one Action Plan per asset from a single Action Plan Template. Each created plan is automatically linked to its corresponding asset via the Related Items framework.

The endpoint is asynchronous: it returns `202 Accepted` with an `operation_id` and enqueues background jobs that create the plans and links in batches of 200. Clients poll the existing async-operations endpoint at `GET /rest/v2.0/companies/{company_id}/projects/{project_id}/submittals/async_operations/{operation_id}` for live progress and a per-asset success / failure breakdown.

Pre-flight validation rejects requests synchronously with `422` when any `asset_ids` entry does not belong to the project (deleted, cross-tenant, or typo'd) — those requests never persist an `Operations::Operation` row or fan out background ...

202.description: Accepted - An async operation has been created and background jobs have been enqueued to create the Action Plans and their asset links.

404.description: Not Found - Template does not exist

409.description: Conflict - Template is in revision and cannot be used

422.description: Unprocessable Entity - Asset linking feature flag is off for the project, the Assets tool is disabled for the project, the template's plan type does not support assets, the template is not published, `template_id` is missing, `asset_ids` is empty, `asset_ids` exceeds the 1,000-asset cap, or one or more `asset_ids` entries do not belong to the project.

template_id.description: The ID of the Action Plan Template to create plans from

asset_ids.description: Asset IDs to create plans for. One Action Plan is created per unique asset id; duplicate ids in the array are deduped before fan-out. Up to 1,000 assets per request.
